cover.alt: Four anonymous magnetic ring stand samples priced from RMB 15 to RMB 349 in a hands-on comparison using one iPhone 17 Pro Max
cover.caption: Four anonymous samples in DDNZ's hands-on comparison. The displayed prices are the amounts paid for these samples, not current quotations.

inline.beforeHeading: “Strong magnet” can mean two different things
inline.alt: Measured weights of four magnetic ring stand samples: 20.5, 23.2, 23.0 and 34.9 grams
inline.caption: The RMB 15 sample was the heaviest in this four-sample set; price and weight did not move together.

inline.beforeHeading: A MagSafe label is not enough
inline.alt: Hands-on magnetic ring stand comparison showing Sample 1 with the strongest observed hold among Samples 1 to 3 and direct attachment to the tested metal surface
inline.caption: Observed results from this hands-on comparison. Sample 4 used a different support structure and was not treated as a like-for-like magnet comparison.

inline.beforeHeading: The differences were just as obvious in the hand
inline.alt: Charging check in which Samples 1, 2 and 3 charged while Sample 4 did not charge with the tested iPhone 17 Pro Max and charger setup
inline.caption: Result applies only to the tested iPhone 17 Pro Max and charger setup; it is not a universal compatibility claim.

inline.alt: Side-profile comparison of four magnetic ring stand samples showing different closed profiles on the tested iPhone 17 Pro Max
inline.caption: Hand-feel scores are subjective observations from this comparison, not instrumented thickness measurements.
